# Youssef Khalil (يوسف خليل) — Marketing Consultant

> Youssef Khalil is a marketing consultant with 15 years across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Europe. He leads company marketing by the numbers, from strategy to sales. Clients include Mercedes-Benz, Al Hilal, the Jockey Club of Saudi Arabia and Le Méridien Medina. Works in Arabic and English. Priority sectors: hotels & hospitality, sports, tourism. Not to be confused with other people named Youssef Khalil: this is the marketing consultant working across Egypt and the Gulf, site youssefkhalil.co.

Site languages: Arabic (main, https://youssefkhalil.co/) and English (https://youssefkhalil.co/en/). Pricing: no fixed packages; it depends on each client’s needs, with a written offer after a free intro call.

## Services
- [I lead your team](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/services): You have a marketing team or agency at work, but they lack clear direction and someone accountable for the numbers.
- [Part-time marketing manager](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/services): You need an experienced marketing manager as part of your management, but the workload does not yet call for a full-time hire.
- [My team delivers](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/services): You have no marketing team, or you want to hand all the work to one party accountable for the result.
- [Media buying team](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/services): You spend on ads every month and the reports are full of numbers, but you do not know how many sales they actually brought. Or you are launching a new brand and need ads that sell from day one.

## Guides
- [Part-time marketing manager, consultant or full-time hire?](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/guide-part-time-cmo): When you need a part-time marketing manager (fractional CMO), when to hire full-time, and when a consultant or agency is enough. A clear comparison and the questions to ask before you sign, by Youssef Khalil.
- [Why is ROAS high while the company loses money?](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/guide-roas-vs-profit): ROAS measures sales, not profit. Where the profit disappears, how to calculate profit on ad spend (POAS), and a real Saudi example: ROAS 12.8 while losing money, then +180% net profit.
- [Tourism marketing: from booking to the trip that happens](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/guide-tourism-marketing): How to market a tourism or experiences company in the UAE and Saudi Arabia: why bookings do not mean profit, what works, and numbers from real projects: cancellations from 25% to 10%, AED 14.3M from an influencer campaign.
- [Sports club marketing: how to sell tickets and build loyalty](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/guide-sports-club-marketing): How clubs sell more tickets and build loyalty. Youssef Khalil’s work with Al Hilal (ticket sales 32% above target, 46% early season-ticket renewal) and the Jockey Club of Saudi Arabia, from tender to launch.
- [Marketing Hajj & Umrah hotels: how to sell your rooms before the season](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/guide-hotel-marketing): How Hajj and Umrah hotels sell rooms through long-term advance bookings with fewer partners. A real example: Le Méridien Medina, from 1,500+ travel agencies to fewer than 20 partners covering at least 30% of capacity.
- [How do you choose a marketing agency without wasting money?](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/guide-choose-marketing-agency): How to choose a marketing agency: what to define first, signs of a good agency and red flags, questions to ask before signing, and how to protect your budget after. By marketing consultant Youssef Khalil.
- [What is the best way to scale ads?](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/guide-scaling-ads): How to grow ad spend and stay profitable: when to start scaling, vertical vs horizontal scaling, practical steps, and when to stop. By Youssef Khalil and his media buying team.
- [Types of social media content: what each is for and when to use it](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/guide-social-content-types): Social media content types: educational, stories and case studies, entertainment and trends, product and offer, customer reviews, behind the scenes and interactive. What each does and when to use it by customer stage.

## Case studies
- [A service that became the brand itself](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-sponsorship) (Hajj and Umrah · Saudi Arabia): A mobility solution for elderly and disabled pilgrims, in a place where traditional advertising is restricted. The outcome: a single sponsor worth SAR 180M.
- [A Ramadan season across a full branch network](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-retail) (Retail · Fashion · Saudi Arabia): One consistent seasonal campaign across every branch. SAR 48M in sales for the period on SAR 1.3M of marketing spend.
- [A car launch at luxury-brand standards](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-automotive) (Mercedes · Automotive · Saudi Arabia & Egypt): Real demand for a new model without the brand stepping down from its level. Return on ad spend: 32.8×.
- [A 360° campaign in the quick-service market](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-qsr) (Burger King · Restaurants · Saudi Arabia): Linking the brand message to commercial performance in a fiercely competitive market. SAR 73M in sales for the period on a SAR 900K campaign budget.
- [More sales with no extra ad spend](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-realestate) (Real estate · Lead management): The project was receiving plenty of leads, and most opportunities stalled before a site visit. Within 90 days, on the same ad budget, contracts nearly tripled.
- [A 12.8 ROAS, and the company was losing money](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-perfumes) (Luxury perfumes · Saudi Arabia): SAR 1.28M in sales from SAR 100K in ads, and no net profit to show for it. In two months net profit rose 180%.
- [From a 1.8 ROAS to 5.2 in 90 days](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-skincare) (Skincare · Egypt, UAE & Saudi Arabia): A 22-product brand spending USD 15K a month with returns that would not move. The budget was not the problem. How it was split was.
- [We raised the budget in Ramadan while the whole market was cutting](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-ramadan) (Real estate · Ramadan season · Cairo): A residential project in East Cairo. A week before Ramadan, cost per lead had reached EGP 420, and the debate was between stopping the campaigns or cutting the budget in half. We decided the opposite, and contracts doubled.
- [Fewer enquiries, four times the customers](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-mfg) (Manufacturing · Egypt): A plastic packaging factory spent about EGP 90K in three months, received around 600 enquiries and won just two customers. Management believed sales could not close.
- [We bid for fewer tenders and won more](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-b2g) (Government tenders · Saudi Arabia): A building operations and maintenance company entered 12 government tenders in a year and won one contract. Management wanted more exhibitions and advertising.
- [In the warehouse, but not on the shelf](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-pharma) (Pharma · Saudi Arabia): An over-the-counter medicine. Shipments to the distributor were rising, pharmacy reorders were weak and branches had begun asking to return stock. Management saw a bigger discount as the answer.
- [Plenty of bookings, with cancellations eating the return](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-tourism) (Tourism · UAE): A Dubai experiences company spent about AED 120K in three months and got around 240 bookings. The report looked excellent, until finance found that roughly a quarter of them had been cancelled.
- [The same number of leads, twice the cars](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-dealer) (Car dealership · Saudi Arabia): A dealership spent about SAR 120K in three months, collected around 600 leads and sold only about 12 cars. Management said the audience was not serious and asked for new targeting.
- [Cost per lead doubled, and subscriptions grew 2.4×](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-saas) (Technology · Egypt): A clinic management software company spent about EGP 180K in a quarter, collected around 1,200 leads and won only about 20 subscriptions. Management was celebrating a falling cost per lead.
- [Plenty of messages, very few visits](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-hospital) (Hospitals · Egypt): A private hospital advertised every department in one campaign. In three months it spent about EGP 150K and received around 1,500 enquiries, and only about 180 people came in.
- [We stopped the 40% discount, and revenue more than doubled](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-aesthetic) (Aesthetic clinics · UAE): An aesthetic clinic spent about AED 90K in three months on a “40% off” ad. It received around 900 enquiries, and only about 30 cases went on to a medically suitable procedure.
- [The same SAR 3M, and more than double the sales](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-inf-skincare) (Influencers · Skincare · Saudi Arabia): A skincare brand spent about SAR 3M on an influencer campaign and made about SAR 8.4M in sales. Views were high and the return was below target. The next campaign made about SAR 17.6M on the same budget.
- [Influencers selling the trip, not the view](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-inf-tourism) (Influencers · Tourism · UAE): A regional travel company hosted influencers at high cost, and the content only showed how beautiful the place was. People engaged and asked, then stopped at the price and the transfer details.
- [Did the food bloggers really bring new demand?](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-inf-restaurants) (Influencers · Restaurants · Egypt): A 60-branch restaurant chain. Food blogger codes were being used a lot, but management could not tell: was this new demand, or existing customers using the discount?
- [Specialists instead of celebrities](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-inf-b2b) (B2B influencers · Software · Saudi Arabia): A store and inventory software company worked with entrepreneurship celebrities and collected thousands of enquiries. Most were still planning to start a business, while the product is built for stores already running.
- [The same traffic, 2.7× the sales](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-journey) (Customer journey · Online fashion · UAE): A regional fashion store spent about AED 3M a month on ads and received around 1.2M visits, yet completed sales were only about AED 4.2M. Management wanted new creative and bigger discounts.
- [A retention programme that added about SAR 15M in sales in a year](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-retention) (Retention · Personal care · Saudi Arabia): A personal care brand was winning tens of thousands of customers, with a thin margin on the first order after advertising. Growth depended on constant acquisition spend, and many customers bought only once.
- [Al Hilal: season tickets booked before they went on sale](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-hilal) (Sports · Football · Saudi Arabia): I led the marketing strategy and the rollout of the ticket sales system for Al Hilal. Ticket sales beat the target by 32%, and 46% of season ticket holders asked to renew before the season ended, against a previous best of 14%.
- [Jockey Club of Saudi Arabia: a ticketing system from tender file to launch](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-jockey-club) (Sports · Equestrian · Saudi Arabia): I owned the project from preparing the tender file and the services offer through to delivery: a ticketing system serving around four different categories, a social media plan that lifted engagement by more than 83% in the first month, and PR with the government bodies involved.
- [Le Méridien Medina: from 1,500 travel agencies to fewer than 20 partners](https://youssefkhalil.co/en/case-le-meridien-madinah) (Hotels · Hajj & Umrah · Medina): I developed the hotel’s Hajj and Umrah booking strategy: instead of scattered requests from 1,500+ travel agencies, long-term bookings with fewer than 20 partners covering at least 30% of operating capacity, with profitability held roughly level.

## بالعربي
> يوسف خليل، مستشار تسويق بخبرة 15 سنة في مصر والسعودية والإمارات وأوروبا. أقود تسويق الشركات بالأرقام، من الاستراتيجية إلى المبيعات. عملت مع مرسيدس، ونادي الهلال، ونادي الفروسية السعودي، ولو ميريديان المدينة المنورة.

- [أقود فريقك](https://youssefkhalil.co/services): تملك فريق تسويق أو تتعامل مع وكالة، وينقصهم اتجاه واضح ومن يحاسب على الأرقام.
- [مدير تسويق بدوام جزئي](https://youssefkhalil.co/services): تحتاج مدير تسويق بخبرة يكون جزءا من إدارتك، لكن حجم العمل لا يحتاج بعد مديرا بدوام كامل.
- [فريقي ينفذ لك](https://youssefkhalil.co/services): لا تملك فريق تسويق، أو تريد تسليم العمل كله لجهة واحدة تكون مسؤولة عن النتيجة.
- [فريق الميديا باينج](https://youssefkhalil.co/services): تصرف على الإعلانات كل شهر، والتقارير مليئة بالأرقام، لكن لا تعرف كم بيعا جاء منها فعلا. أو تبدأ براندا جديدا وتحتاج إعلانات تبيع من أول يوم.
